description: This file defines 'CustomAdapter', a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of strings in an Android application. It includes an inner ViewHolder class with a TextView and click handling logic, along with methods to create view holders, bind data to views, and provide the item count.

classes.name: CustomAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that binds a String array to views for display.

methods.name: CustomAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dataset for the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new view holders by inflating the layout for individual list items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from the dataset to the view holder for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the dataset.

inner_classes.description: Custom ViewHolder class holding reference to the TextView and handling click events.
